headline: President Pezeshkian accuses the US of conducting 'diplomacy through threats' by invoking the 'mother of all bombs'
dek: [VERIFIED FACT -- the statement] President Masoud Pezeshkian accused the US of conducting 'diplomacy through threats' by using and invoking new military capabilities. Full quote: 'They waged war, claiming to stop Iran acquiring nuclear weapons.
sources: President Masoud Pezeshkian (@drpezeshkian), X post Nov 11, via Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: Threat-diplomacy: does naming the MOAB deter Tehran -- or does it prove the talks are a cover for the next strike?

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- the statement] President Masoud Pezeshkian accused the US of conducting 'diplomacy through threats' by using and invoking new military capabilities. Full quote: 'They waged war, claiming to stop Iran acquiring nuclear weapons. Then they used the PrSM missile in Lamerd for the first time. Now they invoke the "Mother of All Bombs" to pursue diplomacy through threats. No contradiction, but a disgrace. Who threatens global peace and security?' [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- the Lamerd figure] Pezeshkian said the US used a Precision Strike Missile (PrSM) in an attack that killed 21 civilians at a sports hall in Lamerd, Iran, on the war's first day. That casualty figure is Pezeshkian's claim, NOT independently verified in the AJ item. [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- the MOAB] AJ: 'US media reports that the Pentagon is considering deploying a Massive Ordnance Air Blast Bomb (MOAB) -- nicknamed the "mother of all bombs" -- against an underground Iranian nuclear site.' No Pentagon confirmation in the item; no MOAB strike has been confirmed (Nov 9 passed with no confirmed MOAB hit). [CONTEXT] Pezeshkian arrived in Antalya, Turkiye, on Wednesday to attend COP31 (Nov 9-20), where he says he will raise US/Israeli 'environmental crimes'. His departure statement (COP31 as a platform) was recorded at 0900-02(b); the MOAB quote itself is new.
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct families: the primary source itself (@drpezeshkian X post -- T1 official/primary) + Al Jazeera (T2, STATE QA, liveblog). DevDiscourse carries the same quote but has NO declared tier and does not count.
sections.what_disputed: No Pentagon statement confirming MOAB deployment or consideration has been published. The Nov 9 date, when US media speculation had a MOAB strike expected, passed with no confirmed MOAB hit. The Lamerd 21-civilian figure comes only from Pezeshkian; no independent casualty verification is in the AJ item. Pezeshkian's framing ('diplomacy through threats') is his characterisation, not a US policy statement.
sections.why_matters: Iran's president just named the bomb Washington is threatening him with -- and the number of civilians he says the last new American weapon already killed.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (AJ liveblog 09:30 GMT = 13:30 ; Pezeshkian X post Nov 11) -- President Pezeshkian accuses the US of conducting 'diplomacy through threats' by invoking the 'mother of all bombs'

totw_analysis: Our read: Iran's president just named the bomb Washington is threatening him with -- and the number of civilians he says the last new American weapon already killed. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Threat-diplomacy: does naming the MOAB deter Tehran -- or does it prove the talks are a cover for the next strike?
